name: BLOSUM62 substitution compatibility prior
description: Sum of frozen published BLOSUM62 substitution entries in half-bit units. The precomputed case contains all 3,202 measured single substitutions; the worker also supports validated combinations. WT is an explicit no-substitution control with empty-sum score 0, not a fitted wild-type measurement. Higher scores indicate greater substitution compatibility in the source alignment statistics.
limitations: Not a prediction of KRAS abundance, DARPin binding, folding energy, pathogenicity, or therapeutic response.
No new model training or calibration; no claimed KRAS predictive performance.
Multi-substitution scores are additive and omit epistasis, position-specific context and structural information.
